svg.title: The right model for each role
svg.desc: Your session orchestrates on the model you pick. The planner has model: inherit, so it rides your session's model: Opus if you orchestrate on Opus, never below Sonnet. Builder, researcher, task-reviewer, code-reviewer and verifier are pinned to Sonnet, and so are the review swarm's five lenses. Opus comes in one place only: build retries a stuck builder lane once on Opus, and if it is still stuck you decide. Design or destructive questions go to you, never to Opus. Never Haiku: turn count beats token price.

text.font-family: 'Space Mono Bold', 'Space Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: THE RIGHT MODEL FOR EACH ROLE
Sonnet is pinned in every agent's file but one: the planner follows your session.
